subject: Two clay-pink buildings and hedge columns at sunset

A mop bucket, a black rubbish bag and other loose items lie at one door, whose curtain is open.

alt.en: View from an upper level over a forecourt to clay-pink buildings with timber rooftop pergolas under a blue, cloudy sky.

subject: Sunset behind a clay-pink building, portrait
description: Portrait frame of the same view as 01_01, a little later: the sun sits on the horizon behind a single-storey clay-pink building with a roof terrace, with tall clipped hedge columns, a lawn, a ball-shaped topiary and small garden lamps in front. alt.en: The sun sets behind a clay-pink building; tall clipped hedge columns and a lawn in front, a wide orange and blue sky above.

description: Dusk view along a paved lane. On the left, a clay-pink building with timber rooftop pergolas rises behind a timber fence with flowering climbers; on the right are a tall clipped hedge column, a lit path lamp and a boulder. A building with tiered roofs is lit at the end of the lane under a violet and blue sky.

description: Daytime view between clipped hedges and red-tipped shrubs to a single-storey clay-pink building with a shingle roof section, an awning and two glazed doors with teal curtains. Two low stepped platforms lead from the lane to the doors; an out-of-focus hedge fills the lower left of the frame.

alt.en: A clay-pink building with teal-curtained glass doors between clipped hedges; low stepped platforms lead up from the lane.

subject: Buildings and rooftop pergolas, late afternoon
description: Late-afternoon view from an upper level across a paved forecourt: a single-storey clay-pink building with two glazed doors and low entrance steps on the left, two-storey buildings with timber rooftop pergolas on the right, palms, a parked golf cart and wooded hills on the horizon. alt.en: View over a forecourt to clay-pink buildings with timber rooftop pergolas, palms, a parked golf cart and hills beyond.
alt.th: มุมมองเหนือลานหน้าอาคาร เห็นอาคารสีชมพูอมส้มที่มีซุ้มระแนงไม้บนดาดฟ้า ต้นปาล์ม รถกอล์ฟจอดอยู่ และเนินเขาที่ขอบฟ้า

subject: Lit doorway and forecourt at blue hour
description: Blue-hour view. On the left, a single-storey building with tall glazed doors, lit curtains and low stepped platforms stands between tall red-tipped hedges that fill a third of the frame; across the paved forecourt are a palm and a two-storey building with rooftop pergolas and a bright light with a star-shaped flare.

alt.en: At blue hour, a building with lit glass doors beside tall hedges faces a forecourt, a palm and a building with pergolas.

description: Frontal blue-hour view of a two-storey building: a glazed entrance at ground level between timber fences, and two timber pergolas on the roof with a bright light between them. Palms and clipped shrubs flank the paved path, and small plaques reading 301 and 302 hang beside it.

alt.en: Front of a two-storey building at blue hour: a glazed entrance, palms either side and two timber pergolas on the roof.

alt.en: A lane at blue hour beside a clay-pink building with rooftop pergolas, a standing stone on the right and a few stars above.

subject: Topiary, forecourt and pergola building at blue hour
description: Wide blue-hour view across a lawn island with a rounded topiary to the two-storey building with twin rooftop pergolas seen in 01_10. A single-storey building stands on the left, and on the right is another pergola building with a stone wall, climbers, a timber porch and a plaque reading 202.

alt.en: Blue-hour view past a rounded topiary and lawn to a building with two rooftop pergolas, clay-pink buildings on either side.
alt.th: ยามหัวค่ำ มองผ่านต้นไม้ตัดแต่งทรงกลมและสนามหญ้าไปยังอาคารที่มีซุ้มระแนงไม้สองซุ้มบนดาดฟ้า ขนาบด้วยอาคารสีชมพูอมส้ม

subject: Lane and lit doorway at blue hour
description: Blue-hour view down a paved lane lined with low path lamps. On the right, a single-storey building with tall glazed doors and lit curtains stands between tall red-tipped hedges; ahead, trees are lit in purple and a bank of cloud sits on the horizon. The foreground is dark and a hedge fills the right edge.

alt.en: From a timber boardwalk at blue hour: a clipped hedge, a lane curving past a standing stone, and pergola-topped buildings.
